game.q: the squirrel can’t lift a single stone. how does it help?
opts: cheers from the shore with a foam finger

wrong.boss: the monkeys would not have gone for that. no.

game.right: YES. sand, one tiny load at a time, shaken into the gaps between the stones.

end.line: in a folk telling, the tiniest helper on rama’s bridge was the one he noticed.

cliff.s1: a king with a whole city waiting.

share: giant monkeys. giant boulders. one tiny squirrel. a folk story on infinite hill
